brief: Long dairy barn about 36 ft by 100 ft: a low milking storey of whitewashed brick and hollow tile, stepped with shallow pilasters between a row of small square stall windows and plank doors, under a tall rounded gambrel (near gothic-arch) hayloft roof of bright galvanized corrugated metal with two round metal ridge ventilators. The gable end shows bare red brick where whitewash has worn off, a hay hood at the peak and a weathered plank lean-to. Plank board fence along the cow yard, corn right up to the fence.
